name: Gasthof Waldruhe
kurzbeschreibung:
**Inn Waldruhe in Virgen**

Welcome to **Inn Waldruhe**, a cozy retreat nestled in the heart of **Virgen**, a picturesque village in the **Tirol** Alps. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse offers warmth, tradition, and breathtaking mountain views.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** cuisine—think crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Gröstl**, and freshly baked **Apfelstrudel**—all crafted with local ingredients. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the **Zillertal** Valley, unwind in our rustic yet comfortable rooms, where every detail reflects the region’s timeless hospitality.

Whether you’re seeking adventure or relaxation, **Inn Waldruhe** promises an authentic taste of **Tirol**’s alpine charm. Come experience the warmth of the mountains—we look forward to welcoming you!
